question: In which Indian state is the 'Pookode Lake' located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pookode Lake** is a scenic freshwater lake in the **Wayanad district in Kerala**, South India.
 
• It is a natural freshwater lake nestling amid evergreen forests and mountain slopes at an altitude of **770 meters** above sea level.
 
• It is **15 km** away from Kalpetta.
 
• It is the smallest and highest altitude freshwater lake in Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
